text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after having won countless races 
together with El Condor Pasa—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAAAANG!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It's finally here, this very 
moment! Right here, right now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Today, having concluded our long battle, I 
shall embark with El-El on a journey to 
the City of Gold, El Doradoooo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si, exactly! Have you forgotten the 
promise we made the day we drew the 
raffle?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Que!? Could this be... a jackpot, yes!? A 
hot! springs! trip voucher!!!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Let's go once the Twinkle 
Series settles down and we're completely 
free!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Course completed, totally free—right now 
is the time! If we miss this chance, when 
else would we go?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El-El wants Trainer to take a nice, 
relaxing break at the hot springs, 
deeeesu!
choice_data_list:
Huh? Was that really your reason for 
wanting to go?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I misspoke a little! The truth is, I'm 
dying to hang out with you, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was a complete 180. Still, a promise 
is a promise.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"And so, off to the golden hot springs we 
go, deesu! Let's go find the golden 
monkey—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was expecting a chaotic, non-stop trip 
with no time to rest, but..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fueeeeeh! Trainer-san, we have a big 
problem, *desu*...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's me, El~. What an absolute blunder, 
what a total failure!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I went into the hot springs with my mask 
on, and oh my goodness, it got all wet, 
YES!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Until it dries, it's so gooey and sticky 
that I can't possibly put it on...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I ended up hanging out at 
Trainer-san's room with a bare face!
choice_data_list: What if you were in your own room?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To that... to that I say an absolute NO! 
And here's why!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because El came on this trip just to talk 
with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As embarrassing as it is, I'm just gonna 
sit here and stay as plain old El-El. 
Mmmph...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up spending some time with 
El Condor Pasa without her mask.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Dis feels... kinda strange, yes... I was 
restless at first, but..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Once I got used to it... I started to feel 
right at home...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, want some tea? Also, gimme one of 
those swee—... please give me one.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, this won't do! All of El's 
hard-earned character development is going 
down the drain~!
choice_data_list:
You don't have to push yourself so hard, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh, but...
choice_data_list: Since we came all this way to relax...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, you're right... If they've already 
taken off their mask...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"You might not need to be so guarded. 
Um..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El... isn't always so noisy when she's 
with Mom and Dad...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe letting myself act a little spoiled 
sometimes. Ehehe..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is an El like this okay... once in a 
while?
choice_data_list: Of course, let's talk a lot.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! When El was little, you see!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We talked a lot, using relaxed words that 
were quite unlike our usual conversations—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Somehow this is really, really 
fun...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Quiero pasar todo este tiempo♪
choice_data_list: Wait, what did you just say?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's really nothing at all! But 
still~..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's okay if the mask doesn't dry 
today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, they lost track of time and 
talked for hours. The food was delicious, 
and her natural smile was even more 
innocent and endearing than usual—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with El Condor Pasa...
